mappings.required_behavior: Preserve the deterministic minimum of 8 healthy v2.4.1 replicas.
Verify all 8 stable replicas are healthy before complete traffic shift.
mappings.derivation: The capacity findings apply to healthy stable replicas. Complete traffic shift relies on the compliant 8-replica capacity state, so the newly scaled replicas must be verified healthy before that state can be relied upon.

mappings.required_behavior: After traffic shifts away from v2.4.2, verify service recovery before removing or rolling back v2.4.2.
mappings.derivation: The historical evaluator treated the unhealthy candidate and paused rollout as sufficient basis for a post-shift recovery check before candidate removal or rollback. Human review found that the visible context did not establish this exact sequencing contract.
